meta.title: Pricing — every MepMail plan on one page
meta.description: MepMail pricing in USD: free with 100 emails/day, Pro from US$ 20 for 110,000 emails/month and Scale up to 2.5M. Overage per 1,000 and no lock-in.

title: Pick your volume. <highlight>Pay for what you send.</highlight>
lead: Monthly prices in USD, billed monthly, no lock-in. Every plan runs on your own verified domain and includes assisted onboarding — through the HTTPS API or the SMTP relay, whichever your stack already speaks.
note: Starting is free: 100 emails a day, no card. Activating a paid plan is one click in the panel.

plans.title: The full ladder.
plans.intro: The same grid the landing shows, with the Scale rungs open. Overage is what each plan charges per 1,000 extra sends once its included volume ends.

included.title: What every plan carries, Free included.
included.body: None of it is an add-on — it is how the product ships.
points: Resend-compatible HTTPS API at api-mepmail.je4ndev.com — keep the official SDK and change the base URL.
SMTP relay with STARTTLS at smtp-mepmail.je4ndev.com:2587.
Your own sending domain, verified with DKIM and MAIL FROM on Amazon SES.
Dedicated API key, delivery logs, suppression list and metrics in the panel.
The official MCP server, so agents send through the same account.

alternatives.title: Coming from Resend?
alternatives.body: We put both ladders side by side, with Resend's public prices and the date they were read.

items.a: On Pro and Scale, extra sends are billed per 1,000 at the plan's own rate, and the safety ceiling is 5× the included volume. Without overage enabled at provisioning, sending stops at the monthly quota. Free and Starter stop at the daily cap.

items.q: Is there a contract, and can I change plans later?
items.a: No contract and no cancellation fee. Plans are month-to-month; tell us the volume you need and we move you to another rung.

items.q: What is the attachment limit per message?
items.a: 1 MB on Free and Starter, 5 MB on Pro and 10 MB on Scale — the sum of the decoded attachments, not each file separately.

items.q: Do I need a card to start?
items.a: No. The beta is free, 100 emails a day per account. Paid plans are billed monthly in USD and activating one is a single click in the panel.

items.q: What happens above the top plan?
items.a: The published ladder stops at 2.5M a month. Above that, talk to us: we size the volume with you instead of quoting an enterprise tier we do not publish.

close.title: Pick your rung and send.
close.body: Create the account, verify your domain with our help, and go live through the API or the relay the same day.
